embedding_description: Shut down a running service plugin gracefully. Halt a background service without restarting the platform. Stop a named service and release its resources. Quiesce a worker or daemon plugin on demand. Turn off a service interface implementation without affecting others.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Service shutdown result with keys: success (boolean indicating shutdown status), service_name (name of the stopped service), message (status description)
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Determine the appropriate next action based on the context and action result.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Stops a running service plugin, gracefully shutting down its operations and releasing resources
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: ServiceNotFoundError: The requested service is not registered. NotRunningError: The service is not currently running. ShutdownTimeoutError: The service did not stop within the allowed time. DependentServicesError: Other services depend on this service and are still running.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For service not found: Verify the service name is correct. For not running: The service may have already stopped or never started. For shutdown timeout: The service may be stuck; consider force stopping. For dependent services: Stop dependent services first before stopping this one.
